en: A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad, cobblestoned boulevard lined with multi‑story historic buildings. Horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing fill the street. Large ornate corner buildings dominate the right side, with trees and shops on the left. At the bottom, printed red text identifies the location as Budapest and names the street Lipót körút / Leopoldring.
